requirement.value: Slayer AND Orator mastery — both, not either

system.description: Three clauses. With Lockdown and Condemn, you may use Lockdown when you successfully Condemn a creature. When you Encourage an ally, you may apply a bane oil to a weapon they have equipped as part of the same action (still paying the 2 IP). And when you Encourage an ally, you may use Know Thy Quarry for that ally's Checks until the start of your next turn.
